四种音频操作不能并行；录音和传输期间 IMU 持续上报，不会中断。: The four audio operations cannot run concurrently. IMU streaming continues during recording and transfer.
开始前打开；建议使用耳机，避免啸叫。: Enable before starting. Use headphones to avoid feedback.
远程保存到戒指后下载；实时接收同时保留设备副本，完整 END 后生成 WAV。播: Remote recordings are saved on the ring, then downloaded. Live reception also keeps a copy on the device; WAV is generated after a complete END. Playback errors are logged; reception and saving continue. Maximum duration uses 0.02 s increments; gain 256 = 1×.
戒指录音保存后，按通知索引自动下载。监听和传输都不中断 IMU。保留原始音频并解: Automatically download ring recordings by the index in save notifications. Listening and transfer do not interrupt IMU streaming. Original audio is retained and decoded to WAV. If missed or interrupted, query recording history to download again.
IMU 无需切换模式；连接后按设备能力开放功能。macOS 地址通常是 UUID: No IMU mode switching is needed. Features become available after connection based on device capabilities. macOS addresses are usually UUIDs.
正在扫描附近的戒指，最长约 8 秒…: Scanning nearby rings, up to about 8 seconds…
历史设备可直接连接，无需重新扫描；最多保留最近 20 台。: Connect to a saved device without scanning again. Up to 20 recent devices are kept.
每次录制一个完整动作，前后留少量静止。每次至少 12 个样本；拒识标定每类至少: Record one complete gesture per take, with a short rest before and after. At least 12 samples per take. Rejection calibration needs at least 3 takes per class; 5–10 or more are recommended.
CSV：无表头，六列逗号分隔；每文件一次重复。训练使用列表中全部有效 JSON。: CSV: no header, six comma-separated columns; one take per file. Training uses all valid JSON files in the list.
{message}。在任一图内水平拖动框选，再次拖动替换，Esc 取消；原始数据: {message}. Drag horizontally in either chart to select a region; drag again to replace it, Esc to cancel. Raw data is unchanged.
使用当前数据目录中全部有效 JSON 训练。训练只使用已保存数据，不向戒指上传模: Train with all valid JSON files in the current data folder. Only saved data is used; models are not uploaded to the ring.
正在后台计算，界面可继续查看…: Computing in the background; you can keep browsing…
响指、敲击等短促动作请先应用短促预设；挥手等选择连续动作。不同类型动作不要未经评: Apply the impulse preset for snaps or taps; use continuous motion for waves. Do not mix different gesture types under one preset without evaluation.
数据或参数修改后，已训练模型失效，需要重新训练才能导出或试识别。低通截止频率必须: Changing data or parameters invalidates the trained model. Retrain before exporting or testing recognition. The low-pass cutoff must be below half the sample rate.
先静止，每次手势后恢复静止。拒识检查不是概率保证，请用普通运动、抖动等负样本验证: Start at rest and return to rest after each gesture. Rejection checks are not a probability guarantee. Test false triggers with negative samples such as ordinary movement and shaking.
开启后，仅通过拒识检查的片段会在曲线上画紫框。: When enabled, only segments passing rejection checks are outlined in purple on the chart.
{stream}。横轴为相对最新样本的秒数（按采样率估算，非设备时间戳）；紫框: {stream}. The x-axis is seconds relative to the latest sample (estimated from sample rate, not device timestamps); purple outlines = recognized segments.

含重力的加速度计读数（比力），不是去重力后的线加速度，也不是移动方向或世界航向。: Accelerometer readings include gravity (specific force). They are not gravity-removed linear acceleration, movement direction, or world heading.
方向基于设备上报的传感器坐标，不代表前后左右、世界航向或移动方向。夹角不是姿态欧:
Direction uses the device-reported sensor coordinates, not front/back/left/right, world heading, or movement direction. These angles are not attitude Euler angles.
Reference bands are for observing acceleration magnitude only, not for detecting device rest, attitude fusion, or calibration decisions.
已冻结：数值、方向、曲线均为历史快照（仍收数）: Frozen: values, direction, and curves are historical snapshots (still receiving data)
校准与升级独占 IMU 或连接；开始前请停止录音和手势录制。: Calibration and updates require exclusive access to the IMU or connection. Stop audio and gesture recording before starting.
校准独占 IMU，停止手势识别；全部验证通过才替换本机配置，不向戒指写参数。校准: Calibration takes exclusive access to the IMU and stops gesture recognition. The local profile is replaced only after all checks pass; no parameters are written to the ring. Calibrated values are not used in gesture training, recording, or recognition.
诊断仅显示 g / °/s，不进入原始录制或训练流水线。: Diagnostics display g / °/s only; these values do not enter raw recording or training pipelines.
不能信任固件包自带的公钥。拒绝测试固件；不支持原始 BIN。: Do not trust a public key bundled with the firmware. Test firmware is rejected; raw BIN files are not supported.
独立来源的公钥 .pem: Public key .pem from an independent source
升级独占连接，期间不能断开或普通退出。发送 100% 不代表成功：等待重启、重连: Updates require exclusive access to the connection; disconnecting or normal exit is blocked. Sending 100% does not mean success: wait for reboot, reconnection, and version verification. Failures are not retried automatically. Recheck the local calibration profile after a firmware update.
